control_failures.control_label: authorisation of switching and access to apparatus
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: preventive action - alarm setting on SG-4100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus on SG-4100 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on SG-4100 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically testing earth leakage and protection settings. SG-4100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus had been bypassed. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 6 March 2007 a corrective action on SG-4100 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility was reviewed against the key safeguard it was raised to restore.
